features:
1. Player Controls (🧍 My Player Tab)
	•	FullBright Toggle – Change lighting brightness, ambient, and time.
	•	Noclip Toggle – Toggle collision off/on for all character parts.
	•	Camera FOV Slider – Adjust the field of view from 70–120.
	•	3rd Person Toggle – Switch between 1st person and 3rd person with mobile-compatible camera rotation (yaw/pitch).

⸻

2. ESP Controls (🛰️ ESP Tab)
	•	Animatronics ESP – Toggle names, outlines, tracers; change color.
	•	Hide Suits ESP – Toggle names, outlines, tracers; change color.
	•	Player ESP – Toggle names, outlines, tracers; change color.
	•	MM (Mini Map/Other Objects) ESP – Toggle names, outlines, tracers; change color if present.
	•	Battery ESP – Toggle names, outlines, tracers; change color for objects with Type = "Battery".
3. Music Player (Misc Tab)
	•	Play individual songs via buttons:
	•	Midnights
	•	Montegn Rando
	•	Tomma
	•	Kirk
	•	Lost Cannon
	•	Volume Slider (0–10, normalized to 0–1).
	•	Stop Music button.
	•	Each song button stops previous song before playing.

⸻

4. Teleport (Coordinates-based)
	•	You can add buttons to teleport to coordinates like:
	•	Generator
	•	Blastor (office)
	•	Fusebox
	•	DoorToLeave
	•	Night3doorToLeave
	•	Arcade
	•	Kids Cove
	•	Prices
	•	Party Hall
	•	Works by directly moving HumanoidRootPart to Vector3.new(x, y, z).
